riskDetails: Protective factors: supportive partner, engaged in treatment, future-oriented goals.

templateFields.dap-data: Client (sample) reported worry about an upcoming work review, rated anxiety 7/10 at its peak, and practiced paced breathing twice this week. Appeared tense at the start of session and relaxed as the session went on.
templateFields.dap-assessment: Anxiety remains elevated but is more manageable; client is using skills between sessions and identified the core thought “If I make one mistake, I’ll be fired.”
templateFields.dap-plan: Continue weekly sessions. Client will complete two thought records before the next session and use TIPP when anxiety rises above 6/10.

mse.orientation: Alert and oriented to person, place, time, and situation
